words.gloss: compared to those who have learned

literal: Compared to beasts, human beings are like; compared to those who have learned shining books, the other people.
translation: As beasts are to human beings, so are the unlearned when compared to those who have studied illustrious books.
modern: விளக்கமான நூல்களைக் கற்றவர்களோடு ஒப்பிடும்போது, கல்லாதவர்கள் மனிதர்களோடு ஒப்பிடும்போது விலங்குகளைப் போன்றவர்கள் ஆவர்.
explanation: This couplet uses a stark analogy to emphasize the value of education. It states that the difference between an unlearned person and an educated person is as vast as the difference between a beast and a human being. The word 'இலங்கு' (shining or illustrious) describes 'நூல்' (books of wisdom), suggesting that true learning brings light and clarity to the mind. Without this learning, a person remains at a level of existence comparable to animals, lacking the refined understanding that defines humanity.
